```{r function-triad_nbda}
#' triad_nbda
#'
#' @param triads a tibble triads
#' @param song_credits a tibble of song credits
#' @param triadists a tibble of triadists as returned by \code{\link{filter_triadist}}
#' @param floating_songs a tibble of songs without a match in song_credits
#' @param missing_song_credits a tibble of songs not registered or without a match in Spotify playlists
#' @param year_range a vector of integers of length 2 giving the year span of the analysis
#' @param subdiv an double giving the subdivision of each year, default to 12.
#'
#' @return \code{triad_nbda} returns a list of plots
#' @details
#' This function fits a Bayesian STbayes model
#' and may require several minutes to run.
#' @export
#'
#' @examples
triad_nbda <- function(
  triads,
  song_credits,
  triadists,
  floating_songs,
  missing_song_credits,
  year_range = c(1973, 1985),
  subdiv = 12,
  min_tvc_songs_triadist = 5L
) {
  # year_range <- c(1973, 1985)
  # subdiv <- 12 # 365.25 for days; 12 for month; 1 for year
  #### Import Data ####
  
  ## Artists that had a long career before our first record of them
  ## And played their first registered TVC more than 2 years after our first record of them
  ## And would nonetheless be considered as not knowing TVC at t0
  unknown_artists <- floating_songs |> 
    dplyr::inner_join(
      dplyr::distinct(triadists, Artist, Year_First_Artist, Date_First_Artist),
      by = dplyr::join_by(name == Artist)
    ) |> 
    dplyr::distinct(name, fake_ISRC, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::group_by(name, Song) |> 
    dplyr::arrange(name, Song, Album_Year) |>
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 1L) |> 
    dplyr::group_by(name, Year_First_Artist, Date_First_Artist) |> 
    dplyr::summarise(Nb_Prior_Songs_Unknown = sum(Date_First_Artist > Album_Date),
                     Career_Start = min(Album_Year),
                     .groups = "drop") |> 
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Nb_Prior_Songs_Unknown)) |>
    dplyr::filter(Nb_Prior_Songs_Unknown > 40 & Year_First_Artist - Career_Start >= 2 & Year_First_Artist >= year_range[1]) |>
    dplyr::pull(name)
  
  ltmp <- build_network_artist(
    song_credits = dplyr::bind_rows(song_credits,
                                    missing_song_credits,
                                    {dplyr::rename(floating_songs,
                                                   ISRC = fake_ISRC)}),
    triads = triads
  )
  data <- ltmp[["data"]]
  byArtists <- ltmp[["byArtists"]]
  all_edges_that_matter <- ltmp[["all_edges_that_matter"]]
  # edges <- ltmp[["edges"]] # not used
  rm(ltmp)
  
  #### Format Data ####
  
  
  t0 <- max(min(byArtists[["Year_First_Artist"]]), min(all_edges_that_matter[["Album_Year"]], na.rm = TRUE), year_range[1])
  t0 <- t0 * subdiv
  tend <- year_range[2] * subdiv
  # event_data <- STbayes::event_data
  event_data <- data |>
    dplyr::filter(!Artist %in% unknown_artists) |> 
    dplyr::filter(
      Artist %in% dplyr::filter(
        dplyr::distinct(byArtists, Artist, Nb_Songs),
        Nb_Songs >= min_tvc_songs_triadist
      )[["Artist"]]
    ) |> 
    # dplyr::filter(Artist == "Rita Coolidge") |> 
    dplyr::ungroup() |> 
    # dplyr::select(id = Artist, time = Year_First_Artist) |> 
    dplyr::select(id = Artist, time = Date_First_Artist) |> 
    dplyr::distinct(id, time) |> 
    # dplyr::filter(id == "Bernard Estardy")
    dplyr::mutate(time = 1970 + as.numeric(time) / 365.25) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(time = time * subdiv) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(time = time - t0,
                  t_end = tend - t0, #max(time),
                  trial = 1) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(time = dplyr::if_else(time < 0, 0, time),
                  time = dplyr::if_else(time > t_end, t_end + 1, time)) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(across(.cols = c(time, t_end), .fns = ~ as.integer(round(.))))
  
  # dplyr::filter(event_data, id == "Rita Coolidge")
  
  edge_list <- all_edges_that_matter |> 
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Album_Date)) |> 
    dplyr::filter(from %in% event_data[["id"]], to %in% event_data[["id"]]) |> 
    # dplyr::distinct(ISRC, from, to, Album_Year) |>
    dplyr::distinct(ISRC, from, to, Album_Date) |>
    # dplyr::select(focal = from, other = to, time = Album_Year) |>
    dplyr::select(focal = from, other = to, time = Album_Date) |>
    dplyr::mutate(time = 1970 + as.numeric(time) / 365.25) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(time = time * subdiv) |> 
    ## Introduce an offset of 1 subdiv
    ## To simulate the meeting of artists
    ## Before the actual observation of one of them (a newcomer ?)
    ## playing a TVC on that particular collab 
    dplyr::mutate(time = time - 1L * subdiv) |>
    dplyr::filter(time <= tend + 1) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(trial = 1,
                  time = time - t0) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(time = dplyr::if_else(time < 0, 0, time)) |> 
    dplyr::group_by(focal, other, trial, time) |> 
    dplyr::summarise(assoc = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |> 
    ## Limit strong connexion (exemple : Barry Mann & Cynthia Weil) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(assoc = dplyr::if_else(assoc > 10, 10, assoc)) |> 
    dplyr::relocate(focal, other, trial, time, assoc) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(across(.cols = c(time), .fns = ~ as.integer(round(.))))
  
  event_data <- event_data |> 
    dplyr::filter(id %in% c(edge_list[["focal"]], edge_list[["other"]]))
  
  data_list <- STbayes::import_user_STb(event_data = event_data, 
                                        networks = edge_list,
                                        network_type = "undirected")
  
  model_full <- STbayes::generate_STb_model(data_list, gq = TRUE, est_acqTime = TRUE)
  
  full_fit <- STbayes::fit_STb(data_list,
                               model_full,
                               parallel_chains = 4,
                               chains = 4,
                               cores = 4,
                               iter = 2000,
                               refresh = 1000)
  
  # full_fit <- readRDS('cmdstan_saves/triad_ndba_fit.rds')
  # full_fit <- readRDS('cmdstan_saves/triad_ndba_fit-1975-1985.rds')
  summary_fit <- STbayes::STb_summary(
    full_fit,
    digits = 3
  )
  
  #### Cumulative diffusion curves ####
  # we need to store num inds per trial to refer to later
  plot_data_obs <- event_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(time > 0, time <= t_end) %>% # exclude demonstrators (time == 0) and censored (time > t_end)
    dplyr::group_by(trial) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(time, .by_group = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_trial = dplyr::n()
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      cum_prop = dplyr::row_number() / n_trial, # this denominator needs to be the number of individuals per trial
      type = "observed"
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::select(artist_id = id, trial, time, cum_prop, type) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  # add in 0,0 starting point
  plot_data_obs <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    plot_data_obs,
    {plot_data_obs %>%
      dplyr::distinct(trial) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(time = 0, cum_prop = 0, type = "observed")}
  ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(trial, time)
  
  ## 2. Extract the draws of estimated acquisition times
  draws_df <- posterior::as_draws_df(full_fit$draws(variables = "acquisition_time", inc_warmup = FALSE))

  # pivot longer
  ppc_long <- draws_df %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::starts_with("acquisition_time[")) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = dplyr::everything(),
      names_to = c("trial", "ind"),
      names_pattern = "acquisition_time\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]",
      values_to = "time"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      trial = as.integer(trial),
      ind = as.integer(ind),
      draw = rep(1:(nrow(draws_df)), 
                 each = length(unique(.$trial)) * length(unique(.$ind)))
    )
  #> Warning: Dropping 'draws_df' class as required metadata was removed.
  
  # thin sample for plotting
  sample_idx <- sample(c(1:max(ppc_long$draw)), 100)
  ppc_long <- ppc_long %>% dplyr::filter(draw %in% sample_idx)
  
  # same as before, we need a way to reference the number of individuals in each trial
  ppc_long <- ppc_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(draw, trial) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(n_trial = dplyr::n())
  
  # we also need to remove individuals predicted as censored, which
  # have value of -1 in predicted data (time > -1)
  ppc_long <- ppc_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      time > 0
    )
  
  # build cumulative curves per draw
  plot_data_ppc <- ppc_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(draw, trial, time) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), n_trial = dplyr::first(n_trial), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(draw, trial) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(time) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cum_prop = cumsum(n) / n_trial)
  
  # add in 0,0 starting point
  plot_data_ppc <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    plot_data_ppc,
    plot_data_ppc %>%
      dplyr::distinct(trial, draw) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(time = 0, cum_prop = 0, type = "ppc")
  ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(trial, time)
  
  # plot it
  p1 <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_line(data = plot_data_ppc, 
              ggplot2::aes(x = time, y = cum_prop, 
                  group = interaction(draw, trial)), alpha = .1) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(data = plot_data_obs, ggplot2::aes(x = time, y = cum_prop), linewidth = 1) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Time", y = "Cumulative proportion informed", color = "Trial") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()
  
  #### Estimated vs. observed acquisition times ####
  acqdata <- STbayes::extract_acqTime(full_fit, data_list) |> 
    tibble::as_tibble() |> 
    dplyr::bind_cols(dplyr::select(dplyr::arrange(event_data, time), artist_id = id))
  
  p2 <- acqdata |>
    ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = (observed_time + t0) / subdiv,
      y = (median_time + t0) / subdiv
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = (observed_time + t0) / subdiv,
        xend = (observed_time + t0) / subdiv, 
        y = (median_time + t0) / subdiv,
        yend = (observed_time + t0) / subdiv
      ),
      color = "red",
      alpha = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2) +
    ggplot2::geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = artist_id)) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Observed time", y = "Estimated time") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()
  
  lout <- list(
    fit = full_fit,
    summary = summary_fit,
    metadata = list(
      calculation_date = Sys.Date(),
      year_range = year_range,
      subdiv = subdiv,
      nb_artists = nrow(event_data),
      min_tvc_songs_triadist = min_tvc_songs_triadist
    ),
    cumulative_diffusion = p1,
    acquisition_times = p2
  )
  return(lout)
}
```

```{r examples-triad_nbda, eval=FALSE}
year_range <- c(1973, 1985)
min_tvc_songs_triadist <- 5L
results_nbda <- triad_nbda(
  triads,
  song_credits,
  triadists,
  floating_songs,
  missing_song_credits,
  year_range = year_range,
  subdiv = 12,
  min_tvc_songs_triadist = min_tvc_songs_triadist
)

print(results_nbda[["summary"]])

STbayes::STb_save(
  results_nbda[["fit"]],
  output_dir = "cmdstan_saves",
  name = paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"), "-triad_ndba_fit-{min_tvc_songs_triadist}TVC-", paste(year_range, collapse = "-"))
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  plot = results_nbda[["cumulative_diffusion"]],
  glue::glue("../{format(Sys.Date(), format = '%Y%m%d')}-cumulative-diffusion-curves-{min_tvc_songs_triadist}TVC-{paste(year_range, collapse = '-')}.png"),
  width = 29.7/2, height = 21/2
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  plot = results_nbda[["acquisition_times"]],
  glue::glue("../{format(Sys.Date(), format = '%Y%m%d')}-estimated-first-TVC-{min_tvc_songs_triadist}TVC-{paste(year_range, collapse = '-')}.pdf"),
  width = 29.7/2, height = 21/2
)
```
